Update the library tests accordingly, and change the changelog and PR description to describe removal without a replacement API. The next release from main is 3.0, so do not retain a deprecated setter.

threads.body: [Config] Removing the 5.1 module also removes the public `otel.instrumentation.lettuce-5.1.enabled` selector. A deployment that used this version-specific key to disable instrumentation will now silently get Lettuce spans, but this migration note only mentions the encoding-events property. Document the selector removal and direct users to `otel.instrumentation.lettuce.enabled` in both the changelog and PR migration guidance.
